AgentDraft.title: AgentDraft
AgentDraft.description:
The fields an agent file fills. Nothing is saved: the person adds the rest, such as the
brief and how Yaksha reaches the agent, then creates the agent.

AgentSource.title: AgentSource
AgentSource.description: Where an agent came from: made in Yaksha, or imported from a file or a provider.

AgentSummary.title: AgentSummary
AgentSummary.description: An agent without its config and knowledge base, for lists.

AssignPersona.title: AssignPersona
AssignPersona.description: One persona for several scenarios of one agent: all of them, or none if one is missing.

AutoNoise.title: AutoNoise
AutoNoise.description:
Sounds that start and stop at random: one under the whole call and a few that come and
go. The seed fixes which ones and when.

BriefModel.title: BriefModel
BriefModel.description: The model that drafts an agent's brief from its config while the person waits.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: What kind of situation a scenario tests. How the caller talks comes from the persona.

Defaults.title: Defaults
Defaults.description: What the server uses for a field that a request leaves out.

DocumentSummary.title: DocumentSummary
DocumentSummary.description: A document without its text, for lists and upload results.

ElevenLabsRegion.title: ElevenLabsRegion
ElevenLabsRegion.description:
Where the ElevenLabs workspace is. EU, India and Singapore workspaces are separate, with
their own API host and keys.

EndReason.title: EndReason
EndReason.description: Who or what ended the conversation, as Yaksha observed it.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error response.

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: A value the caller has and gives when the agent asks for it.

JudgeAgreement.title: JudgeAgreement
JudgeAgreement.description:
How often blind audit labels agree with the machine. A judge version with no such labels
is not listed: it is not yet measured on your agents.

KnowledgeBaseDocument.title: KnowledgeBaseDocument
KnowledgeBaseDocument.description: A knowledge base entry with what the list shows about its document.

KnowledgeBaseEntry.title: KnowledgeBaseEntry
KnowledgeBaseEntry.description: A document the agent answers from, under the name the agent shows for it.

LabelReason.title: LabelReason
LabelReason.description:
What went wrong, or why the judge was wrong. No reason names a cause inside the
agent.

LatencySummary.title: LatencySummary
LatencySummary.description:
The agent's response times in one call: nearest-rank percentiles over the measured
replies, how many replies there were, and how many of them talked over the caller.

Layer.title: Layer
Layer.description:
One sound file in a call: from start_s to end_s of the call, at a gain, looped or once.
A layer with no end plays until the call ends.

Llm.title: Llm
Llm.description:
Any API with OpenAI's Responses endpoint. The caller, scenario writing and the judges
use it.

Metric.title: Metric
Metric.description: One metric's value and the flags it raised.

OutboundConfig.title: OutboundConfig
OutboundConfig.description: How an outbound agent is made to call Yaksha, and how its call is recognized.

Outcome.title: Outcome
Outcome.description: An item's result: a judge's verdict, or what stopped one.

OutcomeGroup.title: OutcomeGroup
OutcomeGroup.description:
How a conversation went, from its status and end reason only. Before any judge, the
groups say what happened, not who is at fault.

PersonaConfig.title: PersonaConfig
PersonaConfig.description: What a persona version pins: the settings plus the voice gender from the voices list.

PersonaDraft.title: PersonaDraft
PersonaDraft.description:
A new persona's fields written from a short line, for the person to check before they
save it. The console picks a voice of `voice_gender` in the language.

PersonaIdea.title: PersonaIdea
PersonaIdea.description: A short line about the caller, such as "angry senior woman on a noisy street".

PersonaScenario.title: PersonaScenario
PersonaScenario.description: A live scenario that uses the persona.

ProviderDraft.title: ProviderDraft
ProviderDraft.description:
The fields an agent read from a provider fills. An agent that answers calls gives the
numbers that reach it; an agent that calls out gives the start request instead.

ProviderVoice.title: ProviderVoice
ProviderVoice.description:
A voice as its provider describes it. `listed_languages` are the languages the provider
lists for the voice in any model; the model decides what the voice can really speak.

Reply.title: Reply
Reply.description: The agent's answer to one caller reply, or to the start of the call.

RuleCounts.title: RuleCounts
RuleCounts.description: One agent rule over a set of judged calls.

RuleGate.title: RuleGate
RuleGate.description: When an LLM rule can apply, decided in code before any model call.

RuleResults.title: RuleResults
RuleResults.description: One of the agent's current rules over the judged calls that ran it as it is written now.

RunCreate.title: RunCreate
RunCreate.description:
Limits that an operator sets, such as the most repeats, are checked where the settings
are known.

RunNumbers.title: RunNumbers
RunNumbers.description: What the evaluations found over some of a run's conversations.

RunVerdicts.title: RunVerdicts
RunVerdicts.description:
The run's verdict numbers over its judged calls: completed calls that no one stopped,
whose evaluation gave a verdict or failed.

ScenarioConfig.title: ScenarioConfig
ScenarioConfig.description:
What a scenario version pins. The instructions and the facts go to the caller. The
criteria never do: they are what the agent must say or do on the call. Agent data goes only
to the agent, in an outbound agent's trigger.

ScenarioDelete.title: ScenarioDelete
ScenarioDelete.description: Scenarios of one agent to delete together: all of them, or none if one is missing.

ScenarioUpdate.title: ScenarioUpdate
ScenarioUpdate.description: A partial change; lists replace the stored list as a whole.

SecretState.title: SecretState
SecretState.description: A saved secret, never its value.

SettingsValues.title: SettingsValues
SettingsValues.description: Every setting that is not a secret.

Share.title: Share
Share.description:
How many of a total, with the 95% Wilson interval of the rate: few calls give a wide
interval.

SoundPlan.title: SoundPlan
SoundPlan.description:
Every sound a call plays behind the caller, decided before the call starts. A retry
plays the same plan.

SoundRead.title: SoundRead
SoundRead.description: One sound the call played behind the caller.

Speaker.title: Speaker
Speaker.description: A person who talks behind the caller, in the caller's language, from start_s on.

SpeakerKind.title: SpeakerKind
SpeakerKind.description: What the person behind the caller does.

StartRequestDraft.title: StartRequestDraft
StartRequestDraft.description:
A start request read from a cURL command, for the person to check. `number_field` names
the body field or query parameter that now holds `{{yaksha.number}}`, if one looked like the
number to call.

Surroundings.title: Surroundings
Surroundings.description: What the agent hears behind the caller. No sounds and no auto noise is a quiet room.

Transport.title: Transport
Transport.description: How Yaksha reaches an agent; phone only today, kept as the seam for other ways.

Trigger.title: Trigger
Trigger.description:
The request sent once for each conversation: a POST carries its values in a JSON body,
a GET in query parameters.

VapiRegion.title: VapiRegion
VapiRegion.description: Where the Vapi organization is. An EU organization has its own API host and keys.

VoiceSettings.title: VoiceSettings
VoiceSettings.description:
A voice of one text-to-speech provider and how it speaks; the id means nothing
outside that provider. The id goes into provider URLs, so dots and slashes are refused.

WaitingReason.title: WaitingReason
WaitingReason.description:
Why queued conversations of a run have not started. Only the run's own limits are
named; anything else is a worker or a number.
